title: Verb にくい
shortExplanation: Express difficulty or complexity; 'hard to', 'difficult to', 'not easily'.
longExplanation: The ～にくい grammar point is used to express that an action is difficult or relatively hard to do. It is used by attaching にくい to the stem of a verb. It can be translated as 'hard to', 'difficult to', or 'not easily' in English.

examples.jp: この字は読みにくいです。
examples.romaji: Kono ji wa yomi nikui desu.
examples.en: This character is hard to read.

examples.jp: このドアは開けにくい。
examples.en: This door is difficult to open.

examples.romaji: Kare no ji wa yomi nikui.
examples.en: His handwriting is hard to read.

examples.jp: この料理は作りにくい。
examples.en: This dish is difficult to make.
